review:
A 5x5 ways game where the Shade stares out at you. If the Evil Eye lands under a winning symbol, it marks the whole win, then turns right or down and spreads it to the edge of the grid, replacing everything in its path with the winning symbol.

A downward spread through a high-paying win can fill a whole column. If the spread passes over the Eye itself, the Eye gets replaced too. The bonuses make Evil Eyes more frequent. 12,500x max.
